entities.summary: Anna Nikolayevna Wolkova, sometimes known as Anna de Wolkoff, was a White Russian émigrée and convicted spy. She was secretary of The Right Club, which was opposed to Britain's involvement in World War II. Her arrest for spying for Germany interrupted plans for a fascist coup by the Right Club.
